name: Tropicana Cookies
summary: **Tropicana Cookies** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] most commonly credited to [[breeder:Bloom Seed Co]]. A cross of [[gsc|GSC]] and [[tangie|Tangie]], it pairs GSC's cookie sweetness with Tangie's citrus genetics. Some sources instead credit Oni Seed Co or Compound Genetics with the cross.
